ABOUT_ME.TITLE_INTRO_DESC: My name is Danil Moskalenko, a Full-Stack Software Developer from Montréal, Canada. I specialize in building   fast, reliable, and user-friendly web applications. My experience covers the full development cycle from designing backend architecture, writing complex SQL queries to building APIs, creating intuitive user interfaces, and  deploying solutions to customers. What drives me is seeing my work in action, helping people solve real problems, and using that momentum to take on even greater challenges.

APPLICATIONS.GROCERY_APP_DESC: Developed a mobile-first grocery list app using React, Firebase, and CSS, deployed as a progressive web app (PWA). Implemented secure authentication, real-time data synchronization, and collaborative shared lists. Built multi-language item support (i18n) and optimized performance for smooth use across devices. Designed to deliver a native-like experience directly from the browser.
APPLICATIONS.PERSONAL_WEBSITE_DESC: Designed and developed a responsive portfolio website from scratch using React and CSS, based on custom Figma designs. Implemented internationalization (i18n) for multilingual support, optimized for performance and accessibility, and deployed for public access. Serves as a personal brand platform, highlighting full-stack projects and technical skills.

PHOTOGRAPHY.GENERAL_DESC_HAWAII: My photography is a way of capturing the mood and rhythm of places I’ve lived and loved. In Hawaii, I focused on natural light, vivid colors, and the calm energy of the ocean and landscapes.
PHOTOGRAPHY.GENERAL_DESC_MTL: Exploring the city’s streets, I focus on calm, raw moments—quiet corners, shadowed alleys, and everyday scenes with a moody, dark-toned aesthetic. My work captures the stillness behind the movement, the grit behind the charm. This is Montreal, stripped down and real.
PHOTOGRAPHY.GENERAL_DESC_NYC: I captured the city in vertical frames, focusing on the most striking moments I experienced. From towering buildings to fleeting street scenes, each shot reflects what truly stood out to me.
